profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is listed as a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC, with SEC CIK 0001818201. The website associated with the company in the material is calgoncarbon.com.

The text harvested from that site does not describe CCC Intelligent Solutions. It describes Calgon Carbon, which the site calls an activated carbon leader in air and water purification, and its product FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated coal-based activated carbon. The site says FILTRASORB has been proven by over 40 years of success in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in the process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial arenas, and that it is made in the United States.

The material holds no products, lawsuits, or MCP servers for the company. It records 305 law exposure matters in Illinois.
